chunks: Muhammad ibn Sinan meriwayatkan dari Abu Mu'adz, dari Abu Arakah, yang berkata:

Aku salat Subuh di belakang Ali (alamah di masjid ini, lalu ia menoleh ke sisi kanannya, dan tampak kesedihan pada dirinya hingga matahari terbit setinggi tombak di atas tembok masjid ini, dan kini tidak ada lagi. Lalu ia menghadap kepada orang-orang dan berkata: 'Demi Allah, para sahabat Rasulullah shallallahu alaihi wa alihi would spend this night in it, alternating between their foreheads and their knees [in prostration and bowing]. When morning came, they rose up dusty and pale, with a mark between their eyes like the knee of a goat. When Allah was mentioned, they would bend as a tree bends on a windy day, and their eyes flowed [with tears] until their clothes became wet.' He said: Then he stood up while saying: 'By Allah, it is as though the people spent the night in negligence.' Then he was not seen laughing until the wicked one did what he did.'

key_terms.الْفَاسِقِ: orang yang fasik (merujuk pada Ibnu Muljam)

ai.seo_question: Apa yang diamati Imam Ali tentang kebiasaan ibadah para sahabat Nabi?
